title: Six New Again 03–04
edition: 2026 direct-mail reissue of Six issues 3 and 4 (digest edition)

description.main: The second volume of Six New Again, the 2026 Comme des Garçons direct-mail reissue of Six, combining issues 3 and 4 of the 1988–91 magazine.
description.extended:
The second volume of Six New Again, the 2026 Comme des Garçons direct-mail revival of Six, combining Issue 3 (1989) and Issue 4 of the magazine art-directed by Tsuguya Inoue.

Issue 3 takes the front cover and Issue 4 the back. The volume reduces the original 40 × 30 cm page to a 30 × 22 cm digest of about 52 pages, issued to customers for the Summer 2026 season. Most of the photographs are by Josef Koudelka, Robert Frank, and Philip Green. Arthur Elgort, Edward Weston, Graciela Iturbide, and Marc Riboud appear as well, with work by Azzedine Alaïa and by younger contributors including Dylan Hausthor, Junko Oki, Kenta Umemoto, and Yu Yamauchi.

Six, short for the sixth sense, ran to eight issues between 1988 and 1991. Rei Kawakubo filled it with photography, art, design, and text, and the label gave it away instead of selling it. The 2026 reissue runs as four volumes. The library holds all four: 01–02, 03–04, 05, and 06+08. This is the second.

notes: Comme des Garçons 2026 Summer direct mail. Issue 3 on the front cover, Issue 4 on the back. page-spread lists about 52 pages on this volume's own listing and 40 in its four-volume set listing. The original Six (1988–1991, eight issues, art direction Tsuguya Inoue) measured 40 × 30 cm. Page count is the dealer's approximate figure (page-spread lists conflicting counts across its listings).
